name: 10x Chromium 5' Gene Expression
summary: 5' transcript profiling with a universal RT primer and barcoded template-switching oligos on the gel beads, so reads start at the transcript 5' end.

name: 10x Chromium 5' Immune Profiling Feature Barcoding
summary: 5' gene expression plus antibody-oligo surface protein tags in one droplet workflow, with V(D)J receptor libraries from the same cells.

name: 10x Chromium Flex (Fixed RNA Profiling)
aliases: Flex Gene Expression; Fixed RNA Profiling
summary: Probe-based single-cell gene expression assay in which RNA probes hybridize to RNA in fixed cells or nuclei before droplet partitioning, with Cell Ranger analysis.

name: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' Feature Barcoding
summary: Antibody-oligo tags captured on the same gel beads as mRNA, giving surface-protein counts per droplet alongside transcriptomes.

name: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' Gene Expression
summary: Droplet 3' mRNA counting where gel beads carry cell-barcoded, UMI-tagged oligo-dT primers co-encapsulated with each cell.

name: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' Solution v1
title: Massively parallel digital transcriptional profiling of single cells
summary: First commercial droplet 3' transcriptome kit, using barcoded gel beads and a microfluidic GemCode device to profile tens of thousands of cells per run.

name: 10x Chromium Single Cell ATAC
title: Massively parallel single-cell chromatin landscapes of human immune cell development and intratumoral T cell exhaustion
summary: Droplet-based scATAC-seq in which nuclei are tagmented in bulk first, then each tagged nucleus is barcoded in a droplet.

name: 10x Chromium Single Cell Multiome ATAC + Gene Expression
summary: Tn5 tagmentation of nuclei followed by droplet capture of tagged open-chromatin DNA and mRNA on the same beads, giving accessibility and expression per nucleus.

name: 10x Visium
summary: Commercial spatial gene expression assay that captures polyadenylated RNA from tissue sections on barcoded spots on a slide.

name: 10x Visium HD 3' Spatial Gene Expression
aliases: Visium HD 3'; HD 3' Spatial Gene Expression
summary: Poly(A)-based whole-transcriptome spatial gene expression assay on fresh frozen tissue, run with the Visium CytAssist instrument.

name: 10x Xenium In Situ
summary: Imaging-based in situ platform mapping hundreds of RNA targets at subcellular resolution in tissue sections using the Xenium Analyzer.

name: 2C-RT
title: 2C-RT Quantifies Genome-Wide DNA Replication Perturbations and Redefines RIF1-CDC7 Regulation of Replication Timing
summary: Replication timing from EdU-labelled S-phase cells sorted by a cell-cycle marker and DNA content, with multiplexed EdU-seq.

name: 2cChIP-seq
title: 2cChIP-seq and 2cMeDIP-seq: The Carrier-Assisted Methods for Epigenomic Profiling of Small Cell Numbers or Single Cells
summary: Carrier-assisted ChIP-seq that adds modified-histone mimics and dUTP-containing DNA carriers to recover histone-mark profiles from 10-1000 cells.

name: 2cMeDIP-seq
title: 2cChIP-seq and 2cMeDIP-seq: The Carrier-Assisted Methods for Epigenomic Profiling of Small Cell Numbers or Single Cells
summary: Carrier-assisted MeDIP-seq that uses methylated mimic and dUTP-DNA carriers to profile DNA methylation from as few as 10-1000 cells.

name: 3'-seq
title: Ubiquitously transcribed genes use alternative polyadenylation to achieve tissue-specific expression
summary: 3' end RNA sequencing method that maps transcript 3' ends across tissues to quantify alternative polyadenylation.

name: 3'Pool-seq
title: 3'Pool-seq: an optimized cost-efficient and scalable method of whole-transcriptome gene expression profiling
summary: Low-cost 3'-end-focused bulk RNA-seq with dual-indexed pooling in 96-well plates and tagmentation.

name: 3'Ribo-seq
title: Large-scale translatome profiling annotates the functional genome and reveals the key role of genic 3' untranslated regions in translatomic variation in plants
summary: Plant translatome profiling that combines polysome profiling, 3' selection and barcoded pooling.

name: 3'T-fill
title: An efficient method for genome-wide polyadenylation site mapping and RNA quantification
summary: Poly(A) stretches are filled in with unlabeled dTTP so sequencing starts right after the tail into the 3'UTR, mapping polyadenylation sites and quantifying RNA.

name: 3AIM-seq
title: 3AIM-seq: Quality assessment of mRNA therapeutics using sequencing for 3' poly(A) tails of in vitro-transcribed mRNA
summary: Ligation-free adapter and 3' end amplification library prep with a dedicated algorithm to measure poly(A) tail length and sequence of in vitro-transcribed mRNA therapeutics.

name: 3C
title: Capturing chromosome conformation
summary: Chromosome conformation capture: crosslink, digest and ligate, then quantify ligation between chosen loci. The ancestor of the C-family.

name: 3D Genome Browser
title: The 3D Genome Browser: a web-based browser for visualizing 3D genome organization and long-range chromatin interactions.
summary: Web browser for visualising Hi-C and other chromatin-interaction data alongside linked regulatory tracks.

name: 3dPCR
title: Sequence specific sorting of DNA molecules with FACS using 3dPCR
summary: PCR-based sequence-specific FACS sorting of DNA molecules that enriches rare long targets for deep sequencing from heterogeneous DNA populations.

name: 3t-seq
title: 3t-seq: automatic gene expression analysis of single-copy genes, transposable elements, and tRNAs from RNA-seq data
summary: Automatic RNA-seq analysis that jointly quantifies single-copy genes, transposable elements and tRNAs.

name: 454 pyrosequencing
title: Genome sequencing in microfabricated high-density picolitre reactors
summary: Highly parallel sequencing-by-synthesis in picolitre fibre-optic wells with emulsion PCR amplification and pyrosequencing readout, demonstrated by shotgun sequencing of a bacterial genome.

name: 4C-seq
title: Robust 4C-seq data analysis to screen for regulatory DNA interactions
summary: Inverse-PCR from a single viewpoint to sequence all of its ligation partners (one-vs-all).

name: 4Cin
title: 4Cin: A computational pipeline for 3D genome modeling and virtual Hi-C analyses from 4C data
summary: Builds 3D models and virtual Hi-C maps of a genomic locus from a few 4C-seq or Capture-C-like experiments.

name: 5'RNA-Seq
title: 5'RNA-Seq identifies Fhl1 as a genetic modifier in cardiomyopathy
summary: Transcriptome sequencing strategy that detects genome-wide changes in 5' transcription start-site usage.

name: 5C
title: Chromosome Conformation Capture Carbon Copy (5C): a massively parallel solution for mapping interactions between genomic elements
summary: 3C library read out with multiplexed ligation-mediated amplification of many primer pairs, mapping all contacts among chosen loci.

name: 5FU-seq
title: Fluorouridine labeling enables spatiotemporal mapping of transcriptomes and enhancers in vivo
summary: Transient 5-fluorouridine labelling that maps nascent transcripts in mouse tissue, and in a transgenic line also active enhancers.

name: 5hmC-SMRT
title: Sensitive and specific single-molecule sequencing of 5-hydroxymethylcytosine
summary: Chemically labels 5-hydroxymethylcytosine for affinity enrichment and kinetic signal enhancement, then reads strand-specific, base-resolution 5hmC on PacBio SMRT sequencing.

name: 5PSeq Explorer
title: 5PSeq Explorer: interactive analysis of co-translational mRNA decay and ribosome dynamics
summary: Web and Docker platform for interactive exploration of 773 uniformly processed 5PSeq datasets across 23 species.

name: 5XP-seq
title: 5´XP sRNA-seq: efficient identification of transcripts with and without 5´ phosphorylation reveals evolutionary conserved small RNA
summary: Small-RNA library prep that tags 5'-phosphorylated RNAs while remaining open to all 5'-terminal modifications, separating 5'P from other small RNAs.

name: 6-base-CUT&Tag
title: Sequencing DNA methylation and hydroxymethylation at co-occurring chromatin features
summary: CUT&Tag-based method that sequences 5mC and 5hmC simultaneously at target chromatin features such as histone modifications.

name: A2Sign
title: A2Sign: Agnostic Algorithms for Signatures-a universal method for identifying molecular signatures from transcriptomic datasets prior to cell-type deconvolution
summary: Non-negative tensor factorization approach that derives cell-type molecular signatures from bulk transcriptomic data without prior cell-type knowledge, ahead of deconvolution.

name: a6A-seq
title: a6A-seq: N 6-allyladenosine-based cellular messenger RNA metabolic labelling and sequencing
summary: Metabolic labelling of mRNA with N6-allyladenosine; iodination makes cyclized A that causes RT misincorporation, so labelled RNA is detected by mutation without pull-down.

name: AAB-seq
title: Rapid discovery of monoclonal antibodies via high-throughput single BCR affinity sequencing
summary: Single-cell BCR sequencing that pairs heavy and light chains with a DNA-barcoded antigen-binding affinity score.

name: AAnet
title: AAnet Resolves a Continuum of Spatially Localized Cell States to Unveil Intratumoral Heterogeneity
summary: Neural network that learns archetypal states along a phenotypic continuum in single-cell data.

name: AASRA
title: AASRA: an anchor alignment-based small RNA annotation pipeline†
summary: Anchor-alignment pipeline that annotates all known small noncoding RNA species at once, including sncRNA variants, from small RNA-seq reads.

name: AAV-mediated direct in vivo CRISPR screen
title: AAV-mediated direct in vivo CRISPR screen identifies functional suppressors in glioblastoma
summary: AAV delivery of a sgRNA library into conditional-Cas9 mice generates autochthonous glioblastoma-like tumours, and capture sequencing of the tumours reveals which mutations drive them.

name: AAV-SB-CRISPR
title: In vivo CRISPR screening in CD8 T cells with AAV-Sleeping Beauty hybrid vectors identifies membrane targets for improving immunotherapy for glioblastoma
summary: In vivo CRISPR screens using an AAV vector carrying a Sleeping Beauty transposon and sgRNA cassette, so that guide integration gives both editing and a screen readout.

name: Aba-Seq
title: High-resolution enzymatic mapping of genomic 5-hydroxymethylcytosine in mouse embryonic stem cells
summary: The 5hmC-specific restriction enzyme AbaSI cuts at modified sites, and the cut ends are sequenced to map 5hmC at high resolution without chemical conversion.

name: ABAA
title: HCK and ABAA: A Newly Designed Pipeline to Improve Fungi Metabarcoding Analysis
summary: Pipeline step that detects and filters non-specific amplicons in fungal metabarcoding sequencing datasets.

name: ABBA
title: A Bayesian Approach for Analysis of Whole-Genome Bisulfite Sequencing Data Identifies Disease-Associated Changes in DNA Methylation
summary: Bayesian smoothing approach that detects differentially methylated regions from whole-genome bisulfite sequencing, adapting to CpG correlation structure and distance between sites.

name: ABC-seq
title: ABC-seq Expands Small RNAs Profiling with Successive Nucleic Acid Structure-Differentiated Enzymatic Recognition
summary: Small-RNA library prep using two randomized adapters and successive structure-differentiated enzymatic reactions to suppress adapter dimers and add UMIs.

name: ABEILLE
full_name: ABerrant Expression Identification empLoying machine LEarning
title: ABEILLE: a novel method for ABerrant Expression Identification empLoying machine LEarning from RNA-sequencing data
summary: Machine-learning method that identifies aberrant gene expression in rare-disease patients from RNA-seq without arbitrary cut-offs or many replicates.

name: ABEMUS
full_name: Adaptive Base Error Model in Ultra-deep Sequencing data
title: ABEMUS: platform-specific and data-informed detection of somatic SNVs in cfDNA
summary: Platform-specific, data-informed detection of somatic SNVs in cell-free DNA from deep sequencing.

name: AbPair
title: Tumor-infiltrating immune repertoires captured by single-cell barcoding in emulsion
summary: Emulsion-based single-cell barcoding that captures natively paired full-length BCR and TCR sequences, extendable to DNA-labelled antibodies for combined protein and RNA readout.

name: AbsCN-seq
title: AbsCN-seq: a statistical method to estimate tumor purity, ploidy and absolute copy numbers from next-generation sequencing data
summary: Statistical method that estimates tumour purity, ploidy and absolute copy numbers from exome or genome sequencing data.

name: ABSOLUTE
title: Absolute quantification of somatic DNA alterations in human cancer.
summary: Computational method that infers tumour purity and malignant-cell ploidy, and detects subclonal and homozygous somatic alterations.

name: ABSSeq
title: ABSSeq: a new RNA-Seq analysis method based on modelling absolute expression differences
summary: Negative-binomial model of absolute expression differences between conditions for RNA-seq differential expression.

name: ac4C LACE-seq
title: NAT10-mediated mRNA N4-acetylation is essential for the translational regulation during oocyte meiotic maturation in mice
summary: Low-input sequencing method that maps N4-acetylcytidine (ac4C) peaks transcriptome-wide from about 50 mouse oocytes.

name: ac4C-seq
title: Quantitative nucleotide resolution profiling of RNA cytidine acetylation by ac4C-seq
summary: Cyanoborohydride reduction of ac4C induces C-to-T misincorporation during reverse transcription.

name: ACAPseq
full_name: Affinity Capture of Polyribosomes followed by RNA sequencing
title: Affinity capture of polyribosomes followed by RNAseq (ACAPseq), a discovery platform for protein-protein interactions
summary: Polyribosomes are captured on an immobilised protein bait through their nascent polypeptides and the enriched mRNAs are sequenced to find protein-protein interaction partners.

name: ACE
title: ACE: a versatile contrastive learning framework for single-cell mosaic integration
summary: Contrastive-learning framework for mosaic integration of single-cell multi-omics datasets with unequal modality coverage, with alignment (ACE-align) and regression (ACE-spec) strategies.

name: Achim spatial mapping
title: High-throughput spatial mapping of single-cell RNA-seq data to tissue of origin
summary: Assigns single-cell RNA-seq cells to tissue locations by comparing their specificity-weighted mRNA profiles with a positional gene-expression atlas.

name: Acidbio
title: Assessing and assuring interoperability of a genomics file format
summary: Verification system that tests bioinformatics tools for correct handling of genomics file-format edge cases.

name: ACT-seq
targets: histone tail modifications; histone variants; chromatin-binding proteins
title: Antibody-guided Chromatin Tagmentation (ACT-seq)
summary: Antibody-tethered Protein A-Tn5 tagments chromatin at the antigen of interest, mapping histone marks and chromatin-binding proteins genome-wide.

name: ACT2-seq
title: Concurrent mapping of multiple epigenetic marks and co-occupancy using ACT2-seq
summary: Concurrently profiles two or three histone marks or chromatin proteins in one sample and maps their co-occupancy.

name: ActiveDriverWGS
title: Candidate Cancer Driver Mutations in Distal Regulatory Elements and Long-Range Chromatin Interaction Networks
summary: Driver-discovery method that tests cis-regulatory modules across whole tumour genomes for enrichment of SNVs and indels.

name: ADAPT
title: Plasma Exosome Profiling of Cancer Patients by a Next Generation Systems Biology Approach
summary: A library of single-stranded oligonucleotides enriched for binding plasma exosomes is used as an affinity probe set whose recovered sequences give quantitative signatures for patient classification.

name: AECT
title: A Deep-Learning Pipeline for TSS Coverage Imputation From Shallow Cell-Free DNA Sequencing
summary: Deep-learning autoencoder that imputes TSS coverage profiles from shallow cell-free DNA sequencing for cancer screening.

name: AESTETIK
title: Representation learning for multi-modal spatially resolved transcriptomics data.
summary: Convolutional deep learning model that jointly embeds spatial position, spatial transcriptomics and histology morphology to define spatial domains.

name: aFARP-ChIP-seq
title: aFARP-ChIP-seq, a convenient and reliable method for genome profiling in as few as 100 cells with a capability for multiplexing ChIP-seq
summary: Atlantis dsDNase-based ChIP-seq that profiles histone modifications and transcription factor binding from as few as 100 cells with multiplexing.

name: Affinity Distillation
title: De novo  distillation of thermodynamic affinity from deep learning regulatory sequence models of  in vivo  protein-DNA binding
summary: Extracts thermodynamic TF binding affinity models from deep-learning models trained on in vivo binding data.

name: AFS-MetaCache
title: A big data approach to metagenomics for all-food-sequencing
summary: Alignment-free k-mer method (with a Spark version, MetaCacheSpark) for detecting and quantifying species composition in shotgun metagenomic food samples.

name: AFT-OCAP
full_name: alkynyl-functionalized trimethylpiperidine enrichment of O-GlcNAc chromatin-associated proteins
title: A chemical method for genome- and proteome-wide enrichment and O-GlcNAcylation profiling of chromatin-associated proteins
summary: Chemical derivatisation of azide-labelled O-GlcNAc chromatin-associated protein-DNA complexes with an alkynyl AFT reagent for enrichment, then MS and DNA sequencing of their binding sites.

name: AftrRAD
title: AftrRAD: a pipeline for accurate and efficient de novo assembly of RADseq data
summary: Bioinformatic pipeline that assembles and genotypes RADseq data de novo and exports results in formats for downstream analyses.

name: AGNOSTOS
title: AGNOSTOS-DB: a resource to unlock the uncharted regions of the coding sequence space
summary: Database-plus-workflow resource that clusters genes of unknown function across genomes and metagenomes and allows integration of new data.

name: AGOUTI
full_name: Annotated Genome Optimization Using Transcriptome Information
title: AGOUTI: improving genome assembly and annotation using transcriptome data.
summary: Uses RNA-seq data to scaffold contigs and merge fragmented gene models in short-read genome assemblies.

name: Agro-STARR-seq
title: Agro-STARR-seq enables  in planta  genome-wide enhancer discovery and AI-empowerd enhancer design
summary: Agrobacterium-delivered STARR-seq libraries in Nicotiana benthamiana leaves for in planta genome-wide enhancer screening.

name: agtools
title: agtools: a software framework to manipulate assembly graphs
summary: Software framework for manipulating genome assembly graphs.

name: AHT-ChIP-seq
title: AHT-ChIP-seq: a completely automated robotic protocol for high-throughput chromatin immunoprecipitation
summary: Fully automated robotic 96-well ChIP-seq protocol that runs about 400 experiments in five days.

name: AIAP
title: AIAP: A Quality Control and Integrative Analysis Package to Improve ATAC-seq Data Analysis
summary: Package that computes quality control metrics and integrative analysis for ATAC-seq data.

name: aiD-NIPT
full_name: artificial intelligence algorithm using cell-free DNA fragment distance for non-invasive prenatal testing
title: Development and performance evaluation of an artificial intelligence algorithm using cell-free DNA fragment distance for non-invasive prenatal testing (aiD-NIPT)
summary: CNN-based NIPT that detects fetal trisomies 21/18/13 from cfDNA fragment-distance rather than fragment-count features.

name: AIDmut-Seq
full_name: TF-directed activation-induced cytidine deaminase mutagenesis sequencing
title: AIDmut-Seq: a Three-Step Method for Detecting Protein-DNA Binding Specificity
summary: A TF is fused to AID so that C-to-T conversions accumulate near its binding sites, which are then read out by whole-genome sequencing and SNP profiling.

name: AIR-SPACE
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
title: A temporal and spatial atlas of adaptive immune responses in the lymph node following viral infection
summary: Spatial transcriptomics combined with paired long-read sequencing of T and B cell receptors within the same tissue section.

name: Airpart
title: Airpart: interpretable statistical models for analyzing allelic imbalance in single-cell datasets
summary: Interpretable statistical models for allelic imbalance in single-cell datasets.

name: Akita
title: Predicting 3D genome folding from DNA sequence with Akita.
summary: Convolutional neural network that predicts 3D genome folding (chromatin contact maps) from DNA sequence alone.

name: aKmerBroom
title: aKmerBroom: Ancient oral DNA decontamination using Bloom filters on k-mer sets
summary: Reference-free k-mer decontamination of ancient oral DNA using Bloom filters.

name: ALaP-seq
full_name: APEX-mediated chromatin labeling and purification sequencing
title: Genomic Profiling by ALaP-Seq Reveals Transcriptional Regulation by PML Bodies through DNMT3A Exclusion
summary: APEX-mediated biotin labelling and purification of chromatin next to PML bodies maps which genomic regions sit near the body.

name: ALE-seq
full_name: amplification of LTRs of extrachromosomal linear DNAs
title: Sensitive detection of pre-integration intermediates of long terminal repeat retrotransposons in crop plants
summary: Amplification of LTRs of extrachromosomal linear DNAs detects pre-integration intermediates of LTR retrotransposons to find active elements.

name: ALEA
title: ALEA: a toolbox for allele-specific epigenomics analysis
summary: Toolbox for allele-specific analysis of epigenomic sequencing data that links allelic variants to histone and chromatin signals.

name: alevin-fry
title: Alevin-fry unlocks rapid, accurate and memory-frugal quantification of single-cell RNA-seq data
summary: Framework for quantifying single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq reads into count matrices, faster and more memory-frugal than comparable tools.

name: ALHENA
title: ALHENA, an H&E encoder distilled from transcriptomic foundation models for multi-scale slide analysis
summary: H&E image encoder distilled from transcriptomic foundation models trained on paired H&E and Xenium spatial transcriptomics, requiring only H&E at inference.

name: AlkAniline-Seq
title: AlkAniline-Seq: Profiling of m7 G and m3 C RNA Modifications at Single Nucleotide Resolution
summary: Alkaline heat and aniline cleave RNA at abasic sites of m7G, m3C, D and ho5C, leaving a 5'-phosphate that allows selective adapter ligation for single-nucleotide mapping.

name: Alleleauto
title: Alleleauto: a pipeline for allele identification and analysis of allele-specific gene expression with haplotype-resolved diploid genome assemblies
summary: Workflow that identifies true allelic gene pairs in haplotype-resolved diploid assemblies, filtering paralogs by Ks and synteny, and runs allele-specific expression analysis.

name: ALLSorts
title: ALLSorts: a RNA-Seq classifier for B-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
summary: RNA-seq classifier that assigns B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia subtypes from expression data.

name: Alpaca
title: Hybrid assembly with long and short reads improves discovery of gene family expansions
summary: Hybrid assembly pipeline combining long reads with short-insert and long-insert short reads to resolve tandem repeats and gene family expansions.

name: AlphaFamImpute
title: AlphaFamImpute: high-accuracy imputation in full-sib families from genotype-by-sequencing data
summary: Imputation package that calls, phases and imputes genome-wide genotypes in outbred full-sib families from low-coverage genotype-by-sequencing and SNP array data.

name: AlphaFISH
title: Cohort-scale Spatial Host-Microbiome Predicts Post-Resection Recurrence in Colorectal Cancer
summary: Sequencing-free spatial profiling of host and microbial signals in clinical colorectal biopsies, paired with a transformer model for recurrence prediction.

name: AlphaGenome
title: Advancing regulatory variant effect prediction with AlphaGenome.
summary: Unified DNA sequence model that takes 1 Mb of input and predicts thousands of functional genomic tracks across modalities up to single-base-pair resolution.

name: alpine
title: Modeling of RNA-seq fragment sequence bias reduces systematic errors in transcript abundance estimation
summary: Estimates sample-specific bias-corrected transcript abundance by modelling fragment sequence bias.

name: AMAR-seq
full_name: Automated Multimodal Sequencing of DNA Methylation, Chromatin Accessibility, and RNA Expression
title: AMAR-seq: Automated Multimodal Sequencing of DNA Methylation, Chromatin Accessibility, and RNA Expression with Single-Cell Resolution
summary: Automated single-cell co-profiling of DNA methylation, chromatin accessibility and RNA expression from the same cell.

name: AMBER
summary: Automated framework that uses neural architecture search to design CNNs for genomic regulatory-feature prediction from DNA sequence.

name: AmbientMapper
title: Empirical Estimation of Ambient Contamination in Combinatorial Single-Cell Methods Using Multi-Reference Mapping
summary: Generative model that maps reads competitively against multiple references to estimate and remove ambient chromatin signal.

name: Amethyst
title: Single-cell DNA methylation analysis tool Amethyst reveals distinct noncanonical methylation patterns in human glial cells
summary: R package for atlas-scale analysis of single-cell methylation sequencing data, including non-CG methylation patterns.

name: AMOUR
title: Deciphering the RNA landscapes on mammalian cell surfaces
summary: Linear-amplification method that profiles RNAs on the surface of intact live cells.

name: AmPair
title: AmPair: automating housekeeping-gene primer design for species-level metataxonomics
summary: Snakemake pipeline that designs and in silico validates species-level primer pairs for housekeeping-gene amplicon metataxonomics.

name: AmpliCoNE
title: Dosage regulation, and variation in gene expression and copy number of human Y chromosome ampliconic genes
summary: Estimates copy number of Y ampliconic gene families from read sequencing depth.

name: AmpliconSuite
title: AmpliconSuite: an end-to-end workflow for analyzing focal amplifications in cancer genomes
summary: Toolkit that detects and classifies focal amplifications, including extrachromosomal DNA, from cancer whole-genome sequencing.

name: AmpliPiper
title: AmpliPiper: A versatile amplicon-seq analysis tool for multilocus DNA barcoding
summary: Automated pipeline for Oxford Nanopore multilocus amplicon-seq DNA barcoding: demultiplexing, haplotype consensus, species identification, phylogenetics and species delimitation.

name: AmpSeqR
title: AmpSeqR: an R package for amplicon deep sequencing data analysis
summary: R package that filters noise and infers amplicon sequence variants from deep amplicon sequencing data.

name: AMULET
title: AMULET: a novel read count-based method for effective multiplet detection from single nucleus ATAC-seq data
summary: Read-count method that detects multiplets in snATAC-seq by counting regions with more than two uniquely aligned reads.

name: Ancestry_HMM
title: A Hidden Markov Model Approach for Simultaneously Estimating Local Ancestry and Admixture Time Using Next Generation Sequence Data in Samples of Arbitrary Ploidy
summary: Hidden Markov model for joint local ancestry and admixture-time inference from sequencing data of arbitrary ploidy.

name: Ancestry_HMM-S
full_name: Ancestry hidden Markov model for adaptive introgression
title: Inferring Adaptive Introgression Using Hidden Markov Models
summary: Hidden Markov model for identifying genes under adaptive introgression and estimating selection strength from population genomic data.

name: ancIBD
title: Accurate detection of identity-by-descent segments in human ancient DNA
summary: HMM-based detection of identity-by-descent segments in ancient human DNA using imputed genotype probabilities.

name: ANEVA
title: Genetic regulatory variation in populations informs transcriptome analysis in rare disease
summary: Statistical framework that quantifies population-level genetic variation in gene dosage from allelic expression data.

name: ANEVA-DOT
title: Genetic regulatory variation in populations informs transcriptome analysis in rare disease
summary: Outlier test that flags genes in an individual affected by a rare regulatory variant, using ANEVA population variance estimates.

name: AniAnn's
title: AniAnn's: alignment-free annotation of tandem repeat arrays using fast average nucleotide identity estimates
summary: Alignment-free algorithm that annotates tandem repeat arrays from average nucleotide identity between repeat units.

name: ANISE
title: Methods for the detection and assembly of novel sequence in high-throughput sequencing data
summary: Targeted assembler for large novel insertions from paired HTS data, with a repeat-resolution step for near-identical repeats.

name: AnnoAudit
title: AnnoAudit: a marker-based protocol for auditing single-cell atlas annotations, with a self-audit case
summary: Marker-based protocol with four convergent checks and an ambient-aware step that audits single-cell atlas annotations before re-analysis.

name: antibody-barcode eCLIP
full_name: antibody-barcode enhanced UV crosslinking and immunoprecipitation
title: Multiplexed transcriptome discovery of RNA-binding protein binding sites by antibody-barcode eCLIP
summary: Multiplexed eCLIP in which DNA-barcoded antibodies are proximity-ligated to protein-protected RNA fragments, so several RNA-binding proteins are profiled in one library.

name: ANTIPODE
title: ANTIPODE Provides a Global View of Cell Type Homology and Transcriptomic Divergence in the Developing Mammalian Brain
summary: Deep-learning variational inference framework that integrates single-cell datasets, finds homologous cell types and parcellates differential expression across species.

name: Anvi'o
title: Anvi'o: an advanced analysis and visualization platform for 'omics data
summary: Interactive analysis and visualisation platform for characterising microbial genomes in metagenomic assemblies and linking 'omics data.

name: AnVILWorkflow
full_name: Genomic Data Science Analysis, Visualization, and Informatics Lab-space (AnVIL) workflow R package
title: AnVILWorkflow: A runnable workflow package for Cloud-implemented bioinformatics analysis pipelines
summary: R package that submits and retrieves bioinformatics workflows hosted on the AnVIL cloud platform.

name: AP-seq
title: Genomic landscape of oxidative DNA damage and repair reveals regioselective protection from mutagenesis
summary: Biotin-tagging of apurinic (AP) sites with an aldehyde-reactive probe, then streptavidin pull-down of fragmented DNA, maps AP-site damage at about 250 bp resolution genome-wide.

name: Ap2N-RNA-Seq
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
title: Detection and sequencing of Ap2N-capped RNAs in human cells
summary: Sequencing method that uses truncated T4 RNA ligase 2 to capture and map Ap2N-capped RNAs.

name: APAIQ
title: Accurate transcriptome-wide identification and quantification of alternative polyadenylation from RNA-seq data with APAIQ
summary: Tool that identifies polyadenylation sites and quantifies their usage transcriptome-wide from standard RNA-seq data.

name: APARENT-Perturb
title: Multiplexed single-cell characterization of alternative polyadenylation regulators
summary: Deep neural network that predicts tandem polyA site usage and perturbation-dependent polyadenylation from cis-regulatory sequence.

name: APARENT2
title: Deciphering the impact of genetic variation on human polyadenylation using APARENT2
summary: Residual neural network that infers 3' cleavage and polyadenylation from DNA sequence and generalises to alternative polyadenylation.

name: APERO
title: APERO: a genome-wide approach for identifying bacterial small RNAs from RNA-Seq data
summary: Detects bacterial small RNAs from paired-end RNA-seq by analysing fragment boundaries to infer transcript 5-prime and 3-prime ends.

name: APEX-Ribo-Seq
full_name: Ribosome profiling integrated with APEX2-based proximity labeling
title: Sequence features and dynamics of subcellular translation revealed by APEX-Ribo-Seq
summary: Ribosome profiling after APEX2 proximity labeling, mapping localised translation across subcellular compartments.

name: APEX-RIP
title: Live-cell mapping of organelle-associated RNAs via proximity biotinylation combined with protein-RNA crosslinking
summary: Peroxidase-catalysed proximity biotinylation combined with RNA-protein crosslinking to isolate and sequence RNAs from subcellular compartments.

name: APEX-seq
title: Atlas of Subcellular RNA Localization Revealed by APEX-Seq
summary: Proximity-labelling RNA sequencing that tags RNAs near APEX2 in defined subcellular compartments to map RNA localisation.

name: Apollo
title: Apollo: Democratizing genome annotation
summary: Browser-based, collaborative software for inspecting and refining genome annotations.

name: APPLES-2
title: Fast and accurate distance-based phylogenetic placement using divide and conquer
summary: Distance-based phylogenetic placement of query sequences on ultra-large reference trees via divide-and-conquer.

name: APTANI
title: APTANI: a computational tool to select aptamers through sequence-structure motif analysis of HT-SELEX data
summary: Tool that identifies target-specific aptamers from HT-SELEX sequencing data using sequence and secondary-structure motif analysis.

name: AQRNA-seq
title: Quantitative mapping of the cellular small RNA landscape with AQRNA-seq
summary: Small-RNA library prep minimising capture, ligation and amplification biases so read count tracks copy number.

name: ARC-seq

title: Fast admixture analysis and population tree estimation for SNP and NGS data
summary: Maximum-likelihood admixture (STRUCTURE-style, including genotype-likelihood NGS input) and population tree estimation from ancestry components.

name: OINC-seq
title: Quantification of subcellular RNA localization through direct detection of RNA oxidation
summary: Photo-controlled oxidation of RNA near a localized bait protein is read as reverse-transcriptase mutations, quantifying subcellular RNA localization without enrichment.

name: OK-seq
title: Replication landscape of the human genome
summary: Sequencing of purified Okazaki fragments to quantify replication fork directionality and delineate initiation and termination zones genome-wide.

name: OKseqHMM
title: OKseqHMM: a genome-wide replication fork directionality analysis toolkit
summary: Toolkit that calls genome-wide replication fork directionality, origins and terminations from Okazaki-fragment sequencing and related datasets.

name: OLAF-Seq
full_name: overlapping linkers on adjacent fragments sequencing
title: A long-read sequencing strategy with overlapping linkers on adjacent fragments (OLAF-Seq) for targeted resequencing and enrichment
summary: Long-read library construction in which Cas9-nickase-cut targeted long DNA fragments keep adjacent-fragment overlaps, enriching targets and retaining phasing information.

name: Oligo-CALL
full_name: Oligonucleotide-inducible CRISPR transcriptional activator-Assisted Lineage Labeling
title: Oligo-CALL: A next-generation barcoding platform for studying resistance to targeted therapy
summary: Oligonucleotide-induced CRISPR activation writes lineage barcodes that are linked to single-cell transcriptomes for clone tracking.

name: OligoFISSEQ
title: 3D mapping and accelerated super-resolution imaging of the human genome using in situ sequencing
summary: Fluorescence in situ sequencing of barcoded Oligopaint probes to image many targeted genomic regions and trace chromosome 3D paths.

name: OligoSeq
title: OligoSeq: Rapid nanopore-sequencing of single-stranded oligonucleotides
summary: Nanopore workflow that combines AmpliSeq and RevSeq to sequence single-stranded DNA oligonucleotides and resolve their reference sequence from basecall frequencies.

name: Oligotyping
title: Oligotyping: Differentiating between closely related microbial taxa using 16S rRNA gene data
summary: Supervised computational method that resolves closely related bacterial organisms within 16S rRNA amplicon operational taxonomic units.

name: OliTag-seq
title: OliTag-seq enhances in cellulo detection of CRISPR-Cas9 off-targets
summary: In-cell CRISPR-Cas9 off-target detection that tags breaks with a stable oligonucleotide and uses triple-priming amplification for higher sensitivity than GUIDE-seq.

name: OMAnnotator
title: OMAnnotator: a novel approach to building an annotated consensus genome sequence
summary: Builds a consensus genome annotation by repurposing the OMA orthology algorithm to integrate gene predictions from several sources, using evolutionary information as tie-breaker.

name: OmicsResonance
title: OmicsResonance: An LLM-assisted cloud ecosystem for interactive and reproducible single-cell transcriptomic analysis
summary: Browser-based, code-free platform for scRNA-seq processing with LLM-assisted annotation and pseudotime, CNV and virtual knockout modules.

name: OmicVerse
title: OmicVerse: a framework for bridging and deepening insights across bulk and single-cell sequencing
summary: Framework bridging bulk and single-cell sequencing, including BulkTrajBlend, which uses a Beta-VAE and graph neural networks to recover cells omitted from single-cell data via bulk RNA-seq deconvolution.

name: Omni-ATAC
title: An improved ATAC-seq protocol reduces background and enables interrogation of frozen tissues
summary: Optimised ATAC-seq protocol with lower background that also works on archival frozen tissue and 50 um sections.

name: OmniRE-seq
title: OmniRE-seq: A Dual-Method Framework for Decoding RNA Editing Dynamics in Disease and Therapy
summary: Computational framework for bulk (RE-seq) and single-cell (scRE-seq) quantification, differential analysis and annotation of RNA editing.

name: OnClass
title: Leveraging the Cell Ontology to classify unseen cell types
summary: Algorithm that classifies cells into Cell Ontology terms, including cell types absent from the training data.

name: Onco-GPS
title: Decomposing Oncogenic Transcriptional Signatures to Generate Maps of Divergent Cellular States
summary: Data-driven framework that places tumour samples with shared oncogenic alterations onto a reference map of cellular states defined by transcriptional activity.

name: OncoGAN
title: In silico generation of synthetic cancer genomes using generative AI
summary: Generative model combining adversarial networks and variational autoencoders that creates synthetic cancer genomes for benchmarking.

name: OncoGEMINI
title: OncoGEMINI: software for investigating tumor variants from multiple biopsies with integrated cancer annotations
summary: Searchable database and filter tool for somatic and inherited variants across longitudinal tumour biopsies.

name: OncoNPC
title: Machine learning for genetics-based classification and treatment response prediction in cancer of unknown primary.
summary: Machine-learning classifier that predicts primary cancer type from targeted NGS tumour profiles, for cancer of unknown primary.

name: ONE-seq
title: ONE-seq: epitranscriptome and gene-specific profiling of NAD-capped RNA
summary: One-step chemo-enzymatic biotinylation, streptavidin capture and NudC elution selectively recover NAD-capped RNAs for transcriptome-wide and gene-specific profiling.

name: OneCell CUT&Tag
title: Simultaneous single-cell profiling of chromatin, transcriptome and surface markers with OneCell CUT&Tag captures epigenomic reprogramming
summary: Single-cell CUT&Tag that reads chromatin marks, the full transcriptome and surface markers from the same cell, down to one-cell input.

name: OneSC
title: OneSC: a computational platform for recapitulating cell state transitions
summary: Computational platform that infers and simulates gene regulatory networks to recapitulate cell state transitions from scRNA-seq.

name: online iNMF
title: Iterative single-cell multi-omic integration using online learning
summary: Online integrative NMF for integrating large, continually arriving single-cell multi-omic datasets at fixed memory.

name: ONT-AmpSeq
title: Complete pipeline for Oxford Nanopore Technology amplicon sequencing (ONT-AmpSeq): from pre-processing to creating an operational taxonomic unit table
summary: Pipeline turning Oxford Nanopore amplicon reads into taxonomically annotated OTU tables through filtering, clustering and polishing.

name: ONT-LibQC
title: ONT-LibQC: rapid quality control of chromatin assay libraries using shallow nanopore sequencing
summary: Shallow Oxford Nanopore sequencing (a few thousand reads) to QC CUT&RUN and Micro-C libraries for adapters, fragment sizes and biological enrichment before deep sequencing.

name: OP-style Strand-seq
title: Resource-efficient Strand-seq library preparation in microliter volumes: a one-pot-style adaptation for standard laboratory infrastructure
summary: Microliter-volume, one-pot-style Strand-seq library prep with pooled MNase digestion and protease inactivation in standard well plates.

name: Open-ST
title: Open-ST: High-resolution spatial transcriptomics in 3D
summary: Open-source sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics for 3D tissue profiling at subcellular resolution.

name: OpenFISH
title: OpenFISH enables same-section spatial transcriptomics and MALDI-MSI integration
summary: Open-source, low-cost, modular FISH-based spatial transcriptomics workflow that is compatible with MALDI mass-spectrometry imaging on the same section.

name: OPT
title: Evidence of off-target probe binding affecting 10x Genomics Xenium gene panels compromise accuracy of spatial transcriptomic profiling
summary: Software that flags Xenium gene-panel probes likely to bind off-target genes by aligning probe target sequences.

name: OpTAG-seq
title: Optical Cell Tagging for Spatially Resolved Single-Cell RNA Sequencing
summary: Light-directed chemical tagging of cells at chosen positions within a multicellular sample, then scRNA-seq of the tagged cells to link position and transcriptome.

name: Optical pooled screens
title: Optical Pooled Screens in Human Cells
summary: Pooled CRISPR screens read out by microscopy: guides are identified by in situ sequencing in each cell, linking perturbation to imaged phenotype.

name: optiCLIP
title: Systemic CLIP-seq analysis and game theory approach to model microRNA mode of binding
summary: Computational framework that calls Ago2 CLIP-seq binding sites by peak overlap reproducibility across replicates.

name: Optimized Repli-seq
title: Optimized Repli-seq: improved DNA replication timing analysis by next-generation sequencing
summary: Single-tube Repli-seq with direct cell sorting into lysis buffer for replication-timing profiling from low-input samples.

name: OPTIMuS PRIME-Del
full_name: Optimal Paired-edits via T7 Insertions for Multiplexed Screening using PRIME-Del
title: Multiplex programming of mappable, molecularly tagged genomic deletions
summary: Paired prime editing that programs tagged intronic cCRE deletions while inserting a T7 promoter and barcode, enabling multiplexed deletion screens with optional single-cell RNA-seq readout.

name: OPUSeq
title: OPUSeq simplifies detection of low-frequency DNA variants and uncovers fragmentase-associated artifacts
summary: Library preparation that adds double-stranded unique molecular identifiers in the same reaction as library PCR to detect very low-frequency DNA variants.

name: ORACLE-tRNAseq
full_name: Optimized Reaction for Accurate Capture of Low-input Entities tRNA Sequencing
title: Deciphering tRNA repertoires and translation coordination during mouse early embryogenesis by ORACLE-tRNAseq
summary: Low-input tRNA sequencing method that profiles tRNA pools from as few as five mouse oocytes.

name: ORCA
title: Visualizing DNA folding and RNA in embryos at single-cell resolution
summary: Sequential FISH tracing of chromatin folding at kilobase resolution combined with RNA readout in single cells.

name: ORCHID
title: An ONT sequencing framework for hantavirus genome assembly, variant analysis, and defective viral genome characterization from whole-segment amplicons
summary: Bioinformatic pipeline for hantavirus genomes that performs reference-guided assembly, variant calling and defective viral genome classification from long-read amplicon data.

name: ORF Capture-Seq
title: ORF Capture-Seq as a versatile method for targeted identification of full-length isoforms
summary: Targeted full-length isoform sequencing that uses collections of cloned ORFs as capture probes to enrich transcripts of chosen genes before long-read sequencing.

name: ORI-Explorer
title: ORI-Explorer: a unified cell-specific tool for origin of replication sites prediction by feature fusion
summary: Feature-fusion AI model that predicts cell-specific origin-of-replication sites from DNA sequence and chromatin-state features.

name: Originator
title: Single-cell RNA-seq data have prevalent blood contamination but can be rescued by Originator, a computational tool separating single-cell RNA-seq by genetic and contextual information
summary: Separates scRNA-seq cells by genetic origin and distinguishes blood-contamination immune cells from tissue-resident cells.

name: ORMAN
full_name: Optimal Resolution of Multimapping Ambiguity of RNA-Seq Reads
title: ORMAN: optimal resolution of ambiguous RNA-Seq multimappings in the presence of novel isoforms
summary: Combinatorial optimisation method that assigns multimapping RNA-seq reads to the minimum set of transcript products per gene.

name: OS-Seq
title: Efficient targeted resequencing of human germline and cancer genomes by oligonucleotide-selective sequencing
summary: Targeted resequencing where the sequencer's immobilised primer lawn captures target DNA and then primes sequencing, so capture and sequencing happen on the same surface.

name: OSPALC
title: An integrative protocol for one-step PCR amplicon library construction and accurate demultiplexing of pooled sequencing data
summary: Single-PCR amplicon library construction with long fusion primers plus accurate demultiplexing of pooled amplicon sequencing data.

name: OT-knn
title: OT-knn: A neighborhood-aware optimal transport framework for aligning spatial transcriptomics data
summary: Optimal-transport method that aligns spatial transcriptomics slices using spatial k-nearest-neighbour context.

name: Otari
title: Variant-resolved prediction of context-specific isoform variation with a graph-based attention model
summary: Attention-based graph neural network predicting tissue-specific isoform abundance and isoform-level variant effects from genome sequence and long-read transcriptomes.

name: OTTER
full_name: Orchestrated Transcriptomic, Tumor-xenograft (PDX/CDX), and Epigenomic Reporting Workflow
title: OTTER: Orchestrated Transcriptomic, Tumor-xenograft (PDX/CDX), and Epigenomic Reporting Workflow
summary: Compiled multi-omics workflow that removes murine host reads from xenograft sequencing, including a bisulfite-aware, strand-aware deconvolution engine.

name: OttoSeq
title: The one-week automated genome-wide optical pooled screen
summary: Automated optical pooled screen that combines in situ sequencing of guide barcodes with cell painting imaging, completing a genome-wide knockout screen in eight days.

name: outbreak.info
title: Outbreak.info genomic reports: scalable and dynamic surveillance of SARS-CoV-2 variants and mutations
summary: Web platform, pipelines and API for tracking SARS-CoV-2 lineages and mutations from sequence-derived data.

name: OUTRIDER
title: OUTRIDER: A Statistical Method for Detecting Aberrantly Expressed Genes in RNA Sequencing Data
summary: Statistical method that detects aberrantly expressed genes (outliers) in RNA-seq data with automatic control for confounders.

name: OutSingle
full_name: Outlier detection using Singular Value Decomposition
title: OutSingle: a novel method of detecting and injecting outliers in RNA-Seq count data using the optimal hard threshold for singular values
summary: Near-instant detection of expression outliers in RNA-seq count data using SVD with an optimal hard threshold for confounder control.

name: ovrlpy
title: Identifying 3D signal overlaps in spatial transcriptomics data with ovrlpy
summary: Computational tool that uses 3D transcript localisation to flag overlapping cells, tissue folds and bad segmentation in imaging-based spatial transcriptomics.

name: Owl
title: Hunting for microsatellite instability in long-read data with Owl.
summary: Quantifies microsatellite instability genome-wide from PacBio long-read genomes using about 140,000 repeat markers.

name: oxBS-Seq
title: Quantitative sequencing of 5-methylcytosine and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine at single-base resolution
summary: Selective chemical oxidation of 5hmC to 5fC before bisulfite conversion gives quantitative single-base maps of 5hmC.

name: OxiDIP-seq
title: Genome-wide mapping of 8-oxo-7,8-dihydro-2'-deoxyguanosine reveals accumulation of oxidatively-generated damage at DNA replication origins within transcribed long genes of mammalian cells
summary: Anti-8-oxodG immunoprecipitation of fragmented DNA maps oxidative damage genome-wide.

name: Pacasus
title: Correcting palindromes in long reads after whole-genome amplification
summary: Tool that corrects palindromic chimeric artefacts in long reads from whole-genome amplification.

name: PACS
title: Identification and genetic analysis of cancer cells with PCR-activated cell sorting
summary: Droplet-based cell sorting that uses TaqMan PCR within single cells to trigger sorting, followed by analysis of the recovered DNA and RNA.

name: PADD-seq
title: Genome-wide mapping of protein-DNA damage interaction by PADD-seq
summary: Runs Damage-seq on ChIP-enriched DNA to map where a protein sits relative to UV and cisplatin lesions at base resolution.

name: PAIRADISE
full_name: Paired Replicate Analysis of Allelic Differential Splicing Events
title: Detecting Allele-Specific Alternative Splicing from Population-Scale RNA-Seq Data
summary: Statistical method that detects allele-specific alternative splicing by treating the two alleles of an individual as pairs and individuals sharing a heterozygous SNP as replicates in RNA-seq data.

name: Paired Hi-C
chemistry: restriction-digest; proximity-ligation; tn5; droplet-microfluidics; facs-sorting; reverse-transcription
title: Droplet Hi-C enables scalable, single-cell profiling of chromatin architecture in heterogeneous tissues
summary: Droplet Hi-C adapted to the 10x Multiome kit to profile chromatin conformation and transcriptome from the same nucleus. Introduced in the Results section, not the abstract.

name: Paired-Damage-seq
title: Simultaneous single-cell DNA damage profiling and RNA sequencing by Paired-Damage-seq
summary: Single-cell joint profiling of oxidative and single-stranded DNA damage with the transcriptome; damage sites are labelled by repair enzymes with biotinylated nucleotides, then cells are split-pool barcoded as in Paired-Tag.

name: Paired-seq
title: An ultra high-throughput method for single-cell joint analysis of open chromatin and transcriptome
summary: Combinatorial-indexing joint profiling of chromatin accessibility and transcriptome in single nuclei.

name: Paired-Tag
title: Joint profiling of histone modifications and transcriptome in single cells from mouse brain
summary: Antibody-guided Tn5 tagmentation plus combinatorial indexing for joint histone-mark and transcriptome profiles per nucleus.

name: PairedFB
title: PairedFB: a full hierarchical Bayesian model for paired RNA-seq data with heterogeneous treatment effects
summary: Full hierarchical Bayesian model for paired RNA-seq counts that allows heterogeneous treatment effects and controls FDR.

name: PAIso-seq
title: Poly(A) inclusive RNA isoform sequencing (PAIso-seq) reveals wide-spread non-adenosine residues within RNA poly(A) tails
summary: Full-length RNA isoform sequencing that also reads poly(A) tail length and non-adenosine residues within tails on PacBio.

name: Palantir
title: Characterization of cell fate probabilities in single-cell data with Palantir
summary: Models differentiation as a Markov process on a diffusion-map graph to give pseudotime, differentiation potential and fate probabilities.

name: PaleoHi-C
title: Three-dimensional genome architecture persists in a 52,000-year-old woolly mammoth skin sample
summary: Hi-C protocol adapted to ancient, permafrost-preserved tissue, capturing chromatin contacts from a 52,000-year-old mammoth sample.

name: PALM-Seq
title: Polyadenylation ligation-mediated sequencing (PALM-Seq) characterizes cell-free coding and non-coding RNAs in human biofluids
summary: Ligation-based RNA-seq of cell-free RNA fragments from biofluids, with RNase H depletion of abundant RNAs.

name: PALMO
title: A comprehensive platform for analyzing longitudinal multi-omics data
summary: Platform of five modules for analysing longitudinal bulk and single-cell multi-omics data, including variance decomposition and outlier detection.

name: Pan-human Azimuth
title: Organism-scale annotation with Pan-human Azimuth
summary: Supervised neural network that maps human cells from many tissues and datasets onto one hierarchical annotation.

name: Pan-Mod-seq
title: Pan-modification profiling facilitates a cross-evolutionary dissection of the thermoregulated ribosomal epitranscriptome
summary: Profiles 16 rRNA modifications in parallel across many samples, used to map modification dynamics across 14 species and growth conditions.

name: Panacus
title: Panacus: fast and exact pangenome growth and core size estimation
summary: Fast, exact estimator of pangenome growth and core size from pangenome graphs.

name: Panagram
title: Panagram reveals pangenome architectures underlying trait variation in plants and animals
summary: Alignment-free pangenome analysis framework that compares genomes by pan-k-mer profiles to link sequence variation to traits.

name: Pandora
title: Pandora: nucleotide-resolution bacterial pan-genomics with reference graphs
summary: Pan-genome reference-graph tool for nucleotide-resolution variant detection and pan-genotyping across bacterial samples.

name: PANDORA-DE
title: Systematic integration of RNA-Seq statistical algorithms for accurate detection of differential gene expression patterns
summary: Combines several RNA-seq differential-expression algorithms by weighting each by its performance on realistic simulated data.

name: PANDORA-seq
full_name: panoramic RNA display by overcoming RNA modification aborted sequencing
title: PANDORA-seq expands the repertoire of regulatory small RNAs by overcoming RNA modifications
summary: Small RNA sequencing with combinatorial enzymatic treatment removing RNA modifications that block adapter ligation and reverse transcription.

name: panEDTA
title: Differences in activity and stability drive transposable element variation in tropical and temperate maize
summary: Optimized open-source algorithm for de novo transposable element annotation across pan-genomes.

name: pangene
title: Exploring gene content with pangene graphs
summary: Tool that builds a gene graph across genomes to identify gene orientation, order and copy-number changes in pangenomes.

name: Pangolin
title: Predicting RNA splicing from DNA sequence using Pangolin.
summary: Deep learning model that predicts splice site strength across tissues from DNA sequence and scores splicing effects of variants.

name: PanGraph
title: PanGraph: scalable bacterial pan-genome graph construction
summary: Scalable pan-genome graph construction for bacterial collections, built from blocks of homologous sequence shared between genomes.

name: PanPA
title: PanPA: generation and alignment of panproteome graphs
summary: Builds graphs from multiple sequence alignments of panproteome protein families and aligns DNA or amino acid sequences back to them.

name: Panpipes
title: Panpipes: a pipeline for multiomic single-cell and spatial transcriptomic data analysis
summary: Workflow suite for multimodal single-cell and spatial transcriptomic QC, integration and reference mapping.

name: PanTE
title: PanTE: A Comprehensive Framework for Transposable Element Discovery in Graph-based Pangenomes
summary: Framework to construct transposable-element libraries for single genomes and graph-based pangenomes.

name: pantera
title: Identification of transposable element families from pangenome polymorphisms
summary: Builds transposable element family libraries from structural polymorphisms across pangenome assemblies.

name: PantheonOS
title: PantheonOS: An Evolvable Multi-Agent Framework for Automatic Genomics Discovery
summary: Evolvable multi-agent LLM framework for automated single-cell and spatial genomics analysis, including agentic code evolution.

name: PAQS-seq
full_name: periodate-dependent analysis of queuosine and sulfur modification sequencing
title: Analysis of queuosine and 2-thio tRNA modifications by high throughput sequencing
summary: Periodate oxidation of queuosine leaves deletion signatures in RNA-seq, also revealing 2-thio tRNA modifications.

name: PAR-CLIP
title: Transcriptome-wide identification of RNA-binding protein and microRNA target sites by PAR-CLIP
summary: Cell-based crosslinking with 4-thiouridine so that crosslink sites appear as T-to-C transitions in cDNA, mapping RBP and miRNP binding sites transcriptome-wide.

name: Paragraph
title: Paragraph: a graph-based structural variant genotyper for short-read sequence data
summary: Graph-based structural-variant genotyper for short-read data that models SVs with sequence graphs and SV annotations.

name: PARE
title: Global identification of microRNA-target RNA pairs by parallel analysis of RNA ends
summary: Sequencing of the 5' ends of polyadenylated, uncapped mRNA decay products to identify miRNA-directed cleavage sites and target RNAs transcriptome-wide.

name: PAREsnip
title: PAREsnip: a tool for rapid genome-wide discovery of small RNA/target interactions evidenced through degradome sequencing
summary: Software that searches degradome (PARE) data for targets of all small RNAs from high-throughput sequencing of a sRNAome.

name: PARIS
full_name: Psoralen Analysis of RNA Interactions and Structures
title: RNA Duplex Map in Living Cells Reveals Higher-Order Transcriptome Structure
summary: Reversible psoralen crosslinking and proximity ligation to map RNA duplexes transcriptome-wide in living cells.

name: PARIS2
full_name: Psoralen Analysis of RNA Interactions and Structures
title: Optimized photochemistry enables efficient analysis of dynamic RNA structuromes and interactomes in genetic and infectious diseases
summary: Optimised psoralen crosslinking and proximity ligation that maps RNA duplexes and interactions in living cells with far higher efficiency than PARIS.

name: Parliament2
title: Parliament2: Accurate structural variant calling at scale
summary: Consensus structural-variant framework that combines multiple SV callers on short-read data, optimised for parallel, low-cost runs.

name: parmigiano
title: An empirical Bayes framework for burden and dispersion association tests helps prioritize rare variants associated with Alzheimer’s disease
summary: Empirical Bayes framework that learns functional-annotation weights for existing rare-variant association tests to prioritise variants in coding and noncoding regions.

name: PARS
title: Genome-wide measurement of RNA secondary structure in yeast
summary: Deep sequencing of RNA fragments cut by structure-specific enzymes to profile secondary structure of thousands of transcripts at single-nucleotide resolution.

name: Parse Biosciences Evercode
summary: Instrument-free split-pool combinatorial barcoding kits for single-cell or single-nucleus whole-transcriptome profiling of fixed samples, scaling to 1 million cells and 384 samples.

name: ParSE-seq
title: ParSE-seq: a calibrated multiplexed assay to facilitate the clinical classification of putative splice-altering variants
summary: Barcoded minigene plasmids in pooled cells quantify the effect of each variant on RNA splicing, calibrated against ClinVar controls.

name: ParStream-seq
title: ParStream-seq: An improved method of handling next generation sequence data
summary: Streaming access that splits sequence data from a remote repository into packets and aligns them in parallel across cores, avoiding storing the full dataset.

name: PAS-seq
title: Complex and dynamic landscape of RNA polyadenylation revealed by PAS-Seq
summary: Sequencing of poly(A) sites to map polyadenylation sites transcriptome-wide and quantify relative abundance of polyadenylated RNAs.

name: PaSCient
title: Learning multi-cellular representations of single-cell transcriptomics data enables characterization of patient-level disease states
summary: Machine-learning model producing patient-level representations from multi-cellular scRNA-seq.

name: PASSPORT-seq
title: PASSPORT-seq: A Novel High-Throughput Bioassay to Functionally Test Polymorphisms in Micro-RNA Target Sites
summary: Pooled reporter bioassay with sequencing readout that tests hundreds of variants in miRNA binding sites (mirSNPs) in parallel for functional effect.

name: PASTE2
title: Partial alignment of multislice spatially resolved transcriptomics data
summary: Partial alignment and 3D reconstruction of multislice spatial transcriptomics data.

name: PASTRI
full_name: Probabilistic Algorithm for Somatic Tree Inference
title: Tumor phylogeny inference using tree-constrained importance sampling
summary: Infers clones and a tumour phylogenetic tree from bulk tumour sequencing data using tree-constrained importance sampling.

name: PAT-seq
title: PAT-seq: a method to study the integration of 3'-UTR dynamics with gene expression in the eukaryotic transcriptome
summary: Targeted 3-prime sequencing of polyadenylated RNA that includes the full native poly(A) tail to report expression, polyadenylation sites and adenylation state.

name: PAT-Seq (polyA-tagging)
title: Comparative RNA-Seq analysis reveals pervasive tissue-specific alternative polyadenylation in Caenorhabditis elegans intestine and muscles
summary: Tissue-specific polyA-tagging isolates mRNA from individual C. elegans somatic tissues, sequenced to map transcriptomes and polyadenylation sites at single-base resolution.

name: Patch-seq
title: Integration of electrophysiological recordings with single-cell RNA-seq data identifies neuronal subtypes
summary: Whole-cell patch-clamp recording followed by aspiration of the cell contents for full-transcriptome single-cell RNA-seq, linking electrophysiology to molecular identity.

name: PATH
title: Defining heritability, plasticity, and transition dynamics of cellular phenotypes in somatic evolution
summary: Phylogenetic framework that quantifies heritability versus plasticity of cell states and transition dynamics from single-cell lineage tracing.

name: Path-seq
title: Path-seq identifies an essential mycolate remodeling program for mycobacterial host adaptation
summary: Method to sequence tiny amounts of Mycobacterium tuberculosis transcripts within up to million-fold excess host RNA.

name: PathFA
title: Probabilistic pathway-based multimodal factor analysis.
summary: Bayesian factor analysis over pathways that integrates multimodal profiling data from small cohorts into interpretable pathway-level factors.

name: pathMap
title: pathMap: a path-based mapping tool for long noisy reads with high sensitivity
summary: K-mer-graph read mapper for long noisy reads that treats chaining as iterative longest-path selection for higher sensitivity.

name: Patho-DBiT
title: Spatially exploring RNA biology in archival formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissues
summary: Pathology-compatible spatial whole-transcriptome sequencing of FFPE tissue sections using in situ polyadenylation and DBiT barcoding.

name: PathoBERT
title: PathoBERT: A Hybrid Attention-Based Genomic Language Model for Read-Level Bacterial Pathogenicity Prediction
summary: Hybrid DNABERT-based genomic language model that classifies individual bacterial sequencing reads as pathogenic or not and aggregates reads to genome-level calls.

name: PathOS
title: PathOS: a decision support system for reporting high throughput sequencing of cancers in clinical diagnostic laboratories.
summary: Web-based decision support system that takes variant data through to a clinical report for high-throughput sequencing of cancers.

name: PatHoST
title: PatHoST: weakly supervised reconstruction of pathogen spatial distributions from host transcriptomes
summary: Weakly supervised model that learns host transcriptional programs predictive of pathogen presence and reconstructs pathogen spatial distributions.

name: PATOPA
full_name: Probabilistic Approach for estimating the Temporal Order of Pathway mutations by leveraging functional Annotations
title: A probabilistic method for leveraging functional annotations to enhance estimation of the temporal order of pathway mutations during carcinogenesis
summary: Maximum-likelihood method inferring the temporal order of somatic mutations at pathway level, weighting mutations by functional impact.

name: Pattern-Filter
title: Pattern-Filter structural validation of single-cell RNA-seq reads reduces artifactual barcodes and improves biological resolution
summary: Preprocessing tool that removes scRNA-seq reads lacking expected anchor motifs and non-canonical barcode or UMI bases before alignment.

name: PatternCNV
title: PatternCNV: a versatile tool for detecting copy number changes from exome sequencing data
summary: Copy-number-variation caller for exome sequencing data with built-in QC and no need for a paired reference per sample.

name: PB-seq
full_name: protein/DNA binding followed by high-throughput sequencing
title: Accurate prediction of inducible transcription factor binding intensities in vivo
summary: In vitro protein/DNA binding on naked genomic DNA followed by sequencing, mapping a transcription factor's binding energy landscape.

name: PB10X
title: Plate-based 10X Genomics-compatible single-cell RNA-sequencing based on Smart-seq3xpress
summary: Plate-based scRNA-seq built on Smart-seq3xpress whose cDNA feeds standard 10x 5' gene-expression and V(D)J libraries, with indexed FACS sorting into 384-well plates.

name: PBA
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
title: Fundamental limits on dynamic inference from single-cell snapshots
summary: Population balance analysis infers cell dynamics from single-cell snapshots using spectral graph theory under stated constraints.

name: PBVI
title: Low-level variant calling for non-matched samples using a position-based and nucleotide-specific approach
summary: Low-level mosaic variant caller for unmatched samples using position-specific empirical distributions of alternate nucleotides from a control dataset.

name: pC-SAC
title: pC-SAC: A method for high-resolution 3D genome reconstruction from low-resolution Hi-C data
summary: Probabilistically constrained self-avoiding chromatin model that reconstructs high-resolution 3D genome structures from low-resolution Hi-C data.

name: PCIP-seq
title: PCIP-seq: simultaneous sequencing of integrated viral genomes and their insertion sites with long reads
summary: Long-read sequencing that captures both the insertion site of an integrated viral genome and the viral genome sequence itself.

name: PCL-seq
title: High-resolution spatial transcriptomics in fixed tissue using a cost-effective PCL-seq workflow
summary: Photocleavable barcoded oligonucleotides and ligation adapters index regions of a tissue section chosen by microscope illumination, giving spatial transcriptomes from frozen or FFPE tissue.

name: PCLIPtools
title: PCLIPtools: a robust framework for identifying RNA-protein interaction sites from PAR-CLIP experiments.
summary: Lightweight suite that statistically calls high-confidence RNA-protein interaction sites from PAR-CLIP read depth and T-to-C transitions.

name: PCP
title: Chromatin architecture mapping by multiplex proximity tagging
summary: Proximity tagging that assigns shared DNA barcodes to molecules (e.g. nucleosomes) associated in 3D, reading nucleosome connectivity and multi-way contacts on single chromatin fibres.

name: PCRD-seq
title: PCRD-seq: proximity crosslinking-induced RNA depletion sequencing for low-input chromatin-associated transcriptome profiling
summary: Enrichment-free profiling of chromatin-associated RNA by proximity crosslinking followed by depletion of non-chromatin RNA.

name: PDA
title: Conserved DNA sequence features underlie pervasive RNA polymerase pausing
summary: Algorithm that calls RNA polymerase II pause sites from nucleotide-resolution occupancy data.

name: PDAL-seq
full_name: permanganate/S1 footprinting with direct adapter ligation and sequencing
title: In vivo detection of DNA secondary structures using permanganate/S1 footprinting with direct adapter ligation and sequencing (PDAL-Seq)
summary: Permanganate traps single-stranded DNA at non-B structures, S1 nuclease cuts there, and adapters are ligated directly to the cut ends for sequencing.
