summary: Combinatorial-indexing scATAC-seq in which unmodified DNA oligo hashes label each sample's nuclei, allowing many specimens to be pooled in one run.

name: ScISOr-ATAC
title: ScISOr-ATAC reveals convergent and divergent splicing and chromatin specificities between matched cell types across cortical regions, evolution, and in Alzheimer’s Disease
summary: Long-read single-cell isoform RNA sequencing coupled with ATAC measures splicing and chromatin accessibility in the same frozen brain cells.

name: scISOr-Seq
title: Single-cell isoform RNA sequencing characterizes isoforms in thousands of cerebellar cells
summary: Single-cell isoform sequencing: full-length cDNA from single cells is read on long reads to resolve isoforms per cell type.

name: scISR
title: A novel method for single-cell data imputation using subspace regression
summary: Imputation method that recovers dropout values in scRNA-seq data using subspace regression.

name: ScisTree2
title: ScisTree2 enables large-scale inference of cell lineage trees and genotype calling using efficient local search
summary: Fast approach for cell lineage tree inference and genotype calling from noisy single-cell sequencing data.

name: scITD
title: Coordinated, multicellular patterns of transcriptional variation that stratify patient cohorts are revealed by tensor decomposition
summary: Single-cell interpretable tensor decomposition that finds coordinated multicellular expression patterns across donors in scRNA-seq cohorts.

name: SCITO-seq
title: SCITO-seq: single-cell combinatorial indexed cytometry sequencing
summary: Splint-oligo combinatorial indexing of DNA-barcoded antibodies on commercial microfluidics, giving high-throughput protein profiles and optional transcriptome co-profiling.

name: scLong
title: scLong: a billion-parameter foundation model for capturing long-range gene context in single-cell transcriptomics
summary: Billion-parameter single-cell transcriptomic foundation model with long-range gene context.

name: scLVM
title: Computational analysis of cell-to-cell heterogeneity in single-cell RNA-sequencing data reveals hidden subpopulations of cells
summary: Latent variable model that accounts for hidden factors such as cell cycle to reveal scRNA-seq subpopulations.

name: Scm6A
title: Scm6A: A Fast and Low-cost Method for Quantifying m6A Modifications at the Single-cell Level
summary: Machine-learning model that predicts single-cell m6A levels from m6A regulator expression and sequence features.

name: scMAC
title: scMAC: large language model-enhanced single-cell functional priors for completing functional context in bulk T cell receptor repertoires
summary: LLM-informed single-cell-guided framework that maps bulk TCR repertoires to T cell functional composition through prototype-regularised alignment.

name: scmap
title: scmap: projection of single-cell RNA-seq data across data sets
summary: Method for projecting cells from one scRNA-seq dataset onto cell types or individual cells of another.

name: scMAR-Seq
title: scMAR-Seq: a novel workflow for targeted single-cell genomics of microorganisms using radioactive labeling
summary: Single-cell genomics of microbes selected by radioisotope-tracked in situ metabolic activity using microfluidics and high-throughput sorting.

name: scMASTER
title: ctDNA Release Heterogeneity in Luminal Breast Cancer Revealed by Single-Cell Multi-Omics Spatial Analysis
summary: Framework that integrates single-cell and spatial transcriptomes, somatic mutations and matched tumour and plasma DNA sequencing to model ctDNA release.

name: scMCodes
title: Epigenomic complexity of the human brain revealed by single-cell DNA methylomes and 3D genome structures
summary: Predicts brain cell types from DNA methylation status at a small set of genomic sites.

name: scMD
title: scMD facilitates cell type deconvolution using single-cell DNA methylation references
summary: Cellular deconvolution framework that builds DNA methylation signatures from single-cell methylation data to estimate cell-type fractions in bulk samples.

name: scMeFormer
title: Deep learning imputes DNA methylation states in single cells and enhances the detection of epigenetic alterations in schizophrenia.
summary: Transformer model that imputes CpG methylation states in single nuclei from low-coverage snmC-seq-type data.

name: scMGFGRN
title: Multi-model biological and sequence information fusion for gene regulatory network inference from single-cell transcriptomics
summary: Multi-model deep-learning framework for gene regulatory network inference from single-cell transcriptomes.

name: scMI
title: Integrating scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq with inter-type attention heterogeneous graph neural networks
summary: Heterogeneous graph embedding with inter-type attention that integrates scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq without motif databases.

name: scMicro-C
title: Single-cell Micro-C profiles 3D genome structures at high resolution and characterizes multi-enhancer hubs
summary: Single-cell Micro-C, an MNase-based 3D genome mapping method with about 5 kb resolution.

name: scMitoMut
title: scMitoMut for calling mitochondrial lineage-related mutations in single cells
summary: R package with a beta-binomial model for calling mitochondrial lineage mutations from single-cell DNA, ATAC and multiome data.

name: scMMGAN
title: Single-cell multi-modal GAN reveals spatial patterns in single-cell data from triple-negative breast cancer
summary: Adversarial framework that integrates single-cell data from multiple modalities into one unified representation.

name: scMNase-seq
title: Genome-wide profiling of nucleosome position and chromatin accessibility in single cells using scMNase-seq
summary: MNase digests FACS-sorted single cells; sub-nucleosome fragments report accessibility and mononucleosome fragments report nucleosome positions.

name: scMoMaT
title: scMoMaT jointly performs single cell mosaic integration and multi-modal bio-marker detection
summary: Matrix tri-factorization method for mosaic integration of single-cell multi-omics that also reports cluster-specific multi-modal bio-markers.

name: scMOTIPh
title: Intravital single-cell behavior profiling reveals disrupted germinal center B cell motility and interactions by EZH2 gain-of-function mutation
summary: Computational framework integrating single-cell behavioural features from intravital imaging with transcriptomic profiles.

name: scMPCDS
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
title: Single-cell profiling of mitochondrial phenotyping-coupled mtDNA genotyping
summary: Single-cell profiling that couples mtDNA mutation and heteroplasmy sequencing with per-cell mitochondrial membrane potential and reactive oxygen species.

name: scMPRA
title: A single-cell massively parallel reporter assay detects cell-type-specific gene regulation
summary: Reporter-library assay read out by single-cell sequencing that measures cis-regulatory activity across several cell types at once.

name: scMspJI-seq
title: Strand-specific single-cell methylomics reveals distinct modes of DNA demethylation dynamics during early mammalian development
summary: Single-cell method for strand-specific 5mC quantification using MspJI, used to resolve strand-asymmetric demethylation in early mouse and human embryos.

name: scMT-seq
title: Simultaneous profiling of transcriptome and DNA methylome from a single cell
summary: The cytoplasm is separated from the nucleus; Smart-seq2 profiles RNA and bisulfite-based scRRBS profiles methylation from one cell.

name: scMTR-seq
title: Combinatorial profiling of multiple histone modifications and transcriptome in single cells using scMTR-seq
summary: Single-cell method that profiles six histone modifications together with the transcriptome in the same cells.

name: scMVP
title: A deep generative model for multi-view profiling of single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq data
summary: Multi-modal deep generative model of paired scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq data giving joint latent representations, imputation and clustering.

name: scNanoATAC-seq2
full_name: Single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using long-read sequencing, version 2
title: Chromatin accessibility landscape of mouse early embryos revealed by single-cell NanoATAC-seq2
summary: Single-cell long-read ATAC-seq for scarce samples such as early embryos, resolving accessibility at repeats, paralogs and imprinted loci.

name: scNanoHi-C
title: scNanoHi-C: a single-cell long-read concatemer sequencing method to reveal high-order chromatin structures within individual cells
summary: Single-cell Hi-C read on nanopore so whole ligation concatemers (multi-way contacts) are sequenced.

name: scNanoHi-C2
title: Single-cell long-read Hi-C, scNanoHi-C2, details 3D genome reorganization in embryonic-stage germ cells
summary: Second-generation single-cell nanopore Hi-C that profiles 3D genome structure and multi-way contacts in individual cells from very small inputs.

name: scNanoSeq-CUT&Tag
title: scNanoSeq-CUT&Tag: a single-cell long-read CUT&Tag sequencing method for efficient chromatin modification profiling within individual cells
summary: CUT&Tag adapted to nanopore long-read sequencing to profile histone marks and TF occupancy in single cells, including repeats and allele-specific signal.

name: scNAT
title: scNAT: a deep learning method for integrating paired single-cell RNA and T cell receptor sequencing profiles.
summary: Deep learning model that jointly embeds paired scRNA-seq and scTCR-seq profiles in a unified latent space.

name: ScNaUmi-seq
title: High throughput error corrected Nanopore single cell transcriptome sequencing
summary: Long-read single-cell transcriptome method combining Oxford Nanopore sequencing with cell barcode and UMI assignment for error-corrected full-length reads.

name: scNMT-seq
full_name: Single-cell nucleosome, methylation and transcription sequencing
title: scNMT-seq enables joint profiling of chromatin accessibility DNA methylation and transcription in single cells
summary: A GpC methyltransferase marks open chromatin before bisulfite conversion, and RNA is split off, giving accessibility, methylation and transcriptome from one cell.

name: scNOMe-seq
title: Simultaneous measurement of chromatin accessibility, DNA methylation, and nucleosome phasing in single cells
summary: NOMe-seq adapted to single cells: a GpC methyltransferase marks accessible DNA, and bisulfite sequencing reads accessibility and methylation together.

name: scNOVA
title: Functional analysis of structural variants in single cells using Strand-seq
summary: Haplotype-aware single-cell tool that links structural variants discovered from Strand-seq to gene expression inferred from nucleosome occupancy.

name: scNovel
title: scNovel: a scalable deep learning-based network for novel rare cell discovery in single-cell transcriptomics
summary: Deep learning network that finds novel rare cell types in single-cell RNA-seq data without prior annotation.

name: scNT-seq
full_name: Single-cell metabolically labeled new RNA tagging sequencing
title: Massively parallel and time-resolved RNA sequencing in single cells with scNT-seq
summary: Droplet-based single-cell RNA-seq that chemically marks newly transcribed mRNA with T-to-C substitutions on barcoded beads to profile new and old transcriptomes together.

name: SCODE
title: SCODE: an efficient regulatory network inference algorithm from single-cell RNA-Seq during differentiation
summary: Efficient algorithm that infers regulatory networks from single-cell RNA-seq during differentiation using ordinary differential equations.

name: scOLAR
title: scOLAR: Ontology-Anchored Open-Set Annotation of Single-Cell RNA-seq Data
summary: Ontology-guided open-set annotation of scRNA-seq that flags novel cell populations absent from the reference.

name: scONE-seq
title: scONE-seq: A single-cell multi-omics method enables simultaneous dissection of phenotype and genotype heterogeneity from frozen tumors
summary: One-tube single-cell whole-genome DNA and RNA amplification that works on frozen tumour samples.

name: scooby
title: scooby: modeling multimodal genomic profiles from DNA sequence at single-cell resolution
summary: Sequence-to-profile model that predicts single-cell RNA coverage and ATAC insertion tracks using a cell-specific decoder on Borzoi.

name: Scooby-2
title: Scooby-2: fine-tuning AlphaGenome for single-cell genomic track prediction
summary: Fine-tunes AlphaGenome with a cell-specific decoder to predict single-cell RNA-seq and chromatin-accessibility tracks from DNA sequence.

name: SCOPE
full_name: Spatial reConstruction via Oligonucleotide Proximity Encoding
summary: Optics-free spatial reconstruction: relative positions of DNA-barcoded beads are inferred from sequenced chimeric molecules formed between diffusing sender and tethered receiver oligonucleotides.

name: SCOPE-Seq
full_name: Single Cell Optical Phenotyping and Expression sequencing
title: SCOPE-Seq: a scalable technology for linking live cell imaging and single-cell RNA sequencing
summary: Microfluidics with optically decodable beads links live-cell imaging phenotypes to single-cell RNA sequencing (Single Cell Optical Phenotyping and Expression).

name: SCORE
title: SCORE: Smart Consensus Of RNA Expression-a consensus tool for detecting differentially expressed genes in bacteria
summary: Snakemake-based consensus workflow that combines several differential-expression tools for bacterial RNA-seq.

name: SCORPIUS
title: SCORPIUS improves trajectory inference and identifies novel modules in dendritic cell development
summary: Trajectory inference method that orders single cells along a developmental path and identifies modules along it.

name: SCOTIA
full_name: spatially constrained optimal transport interaction analysis
title: Spatially resolved analysis of pancreatic cancer identifies therapy-associated remodeling of the tumor microenvironment
summary: Optimal-transport model of cell-cell ligand-receptor interactions using spatial distance and expression in spatial transcriptomics.

name: scPAISO
title: Identification and quantification of alternative polyadenylation sites in single cell RNA-seq data using scPAISO
summary: Computational pipeline that uses Read1 of 3' tag scRNA-seq to identify polyadenylation sites and quantify PAS isoforms.

name: scPCOR-seq
full_name: single-cell Profiling of Chromatin Occupancy and RNAs Sequencing

summary: Single-cell method that profiles histone marks or RNA polymerase II binding together with RNA from the same cells.

name: scPFA
title: Lineage-informed factor analysis reveals heritable programs of single-cell gene expression
summary: Phylogenetic factor analysis that models single-cell expression programs evolving along lineage trees.

name: scPhere
title: Deep generative model embedding of single-cell RNA-Seq profiles on hyperspheres and hyperbolic spaces
summary: Deep generative model embedding scRNA-seq profiles on hyperspheres or hyperbolic space.

name: scPipe
title: scPipe: A flexible R/Bioconductor preprocessing pipeline for single-cell RNA-sequencing data
summary: R/Bioconductor pipeline for scRNA-seq preprocessing: barcode demultiplexing, alignment, UMI-aware gene counting and QC across several protocols.

name: scPloidyR
title: Integrative Modeling of Read Depth and B-Allele Frequency Improves Single-Cell Copy Number Calling from Targeted DNA Sequencing Panels
summary: Hidden Markov model that jointly models read depth and B-allele frequency to call single-cell copy number from targeted Tapestri panels.

name: scPoli
title: Population-level integration of single-cell datasets enables multi-scale analysis across samples
summary: Open-world generative learner for population-level single-cell integration, label transfer and sample-level variation.

name: scPower
title: scPower accelerates and optimizes the design of multi-sample single cell transcriptomic studies
summary: Statistical framework for design and power analysis of multi-sample single-cell transcriptomic experiments.

name: scPred
title: scPred: accurate supervised method for cell-type classification from single-cell RNA-seq data
summary: Supervised single-cell classifier using feature selection on reduced dimensions and machine learning for cell-type assignment.

name: scPRS
title: Single-cell polygenic risk scores dissect cellular and molecular heterogeneity of complex human diseases
summary: Graph neural network computing single-cell-resolved polygenic risk scores from reference scATAC-seq profiles.

name: scPT-seq
title: Direct detection of CRISPR mutations and transcriptional responses at single cell resolution  in vivo
summary: Single-cell RNA assay that reads CRISPR-induced mutations at base-pair resolution alongside transcriptomes in vivo.

name: scquantum
title: Delineating the copy-number substructure of metastatic tumors with CopyKit
summary: Companion method for estimating integer copy numbers from single-cell DNA copy-number data, introduced with CopyKit.

name: SCRB-seq
title: Characterization of directed differentiation by high-throughput single-cell RNA-Seq
summary: Plate-based digital gene-expression scRNA-seq protocol that surveys mRNA from thousands of single cells.

name: scRCAT-seq
full_name: Single-cell RNA cap and tail sequencing
title: Single-cell RNA cap and tail sequencing (scRCAT-seq) reveals subtype-specific isoforms differing in transcript demarcation
summary: Short-read single-cell method that tags both transcript ends during a modified Smart-seq2 protocol, then tagments and captures the 5' or 3' ends to demarcate isoform boundaries.

name: scReMeMber-Seq
title: Joint recording of past and present transcriptomes reconstructs single-cell trajectories
summary: Methylation-based cell-memory recorder: pulse-induced DCM-Polr2b marks past transcription in DNA methylation, read out with scMT-seq alongside the present transcriptome.

name: scRep
title: scRep: A Latent-Space Self-Distilled Foundation Model for Single-Cell Representation Learning
summary: Latent-space self-distillation foundation model for scRNA-seq representation learning.

name: scRepli-seq
title: Single-cell replication profiling to measure stochastic variation in mammalian replication timing.

name: scRhythmBayes
title: Decoding Cell-level Circadian Phase and Rhythm-state Remodeling in Single-cell Transcriptomes With scRhythmBayes
summary: Probabilistic algorithm that infers cell-level circadian phase and gene-level rhythm-state changes from single-cell transcriptomes.

name: Scriabin
title: Comparative analysis of cell-cell communication at single-cell resolution
summary: Infers cell-cell communication at single-cell resolution without cell aggregation or downsampling, enabling comparative communication networks across conditions and timepoints from scRNA-seq.

name: sCRilecs-seq
full_name: subsets of CRISPR interference libraries extracted by fluorescence activated cell sorting coupled to next generation sequencing
title: Amoxicillin-resistant Streptococcus pneumoniae can be resensitized by targeting the mevalonate pathway as indicated by sCRilecs-seq
summary: Genome-wide CRISPRi screen in bacteria where cells are sorted by FACS on a phenotype such as cell size and guides are read out by sequencing.

name: scRIPT
full_name: single-cell Rapid Integrated Platform for Tracing
title: scRIPT: a rapid, high-coverage single-cell lineage-tracing method applied to the hematoendothelial differentiation of embryonic stem cells
summary: Rapid RNP-based CRISPR barcoding with fluorescent reporter insertion, sorting of informative cells and short-read library prep for clonal and transcriptome readouts.

name: scROSHI
full_name: robust supervised hierarchical identification of single cells
title: scROSHI: robust supervised hierarchical identification of single cells.
summary: Training-free hierarchical cell-type classifier that assigns single cells to cell types using previously curated cell-type marker gene lists.

name: scRR-seq
title: scRepli-RamDA-seq: a multi-omics technology enabling the analysis of gene expression dynamics during S-phase
summary: Single-cell multi-omics giving DNA replication profiles and full-length total RNA from the same cell, haplotype-specific.

name: scRRBS
title: Single-cell methylome landscapes of mouse embryonic stem cells and early embryos analyzed using reduced representation bisulfite sequencing
summary: Reduced representation bisulfite sequencing applied to single cells, enriching CpG-rich regions for a single-cell methylome.

name: Scrublet
title: Scrublet: Computational Identification of Cell Doublets in Single-Cell Transcriptomic Data
summary: Detects doublets by scoring each cell against simulated doublets in a nearest-neighbour graph.

name: scSeqComm
title: Identify, quantify and characterize cellular communication from single-cell RNA sequencing data with scSeqComm
summary: Quantifies intercellular and intracellular signalling evidence from scRNA-seq, combining ligand-receptor and downstream target-gene expression.

name: SCSit
title: SCSit: A high-efficiency preprocessing tool for single-cell sequencing data from SPLiT-seq
summary: Preprocessing tool that identifies SPLiT-seq combinatorial barcodes and UMIs and labels reads faster and with more retained reads than the original pipeline.

name: scSLAM-seq
full_name: Single-cell thiol(SH)-linked alkylation of RNA for metabolic labelling sequencing
title: scSLAM-seq reveals core features of transcription dynamics in single cells
summary: Single-cell SLAM-seq that uses thiol alkylation of 4sU-labeled RNA to separate new from old transcripts in each cell.

name: scSLIDE
title: Reconstructing developmental and disease progression with sample-level embeddings
summary: Framework of sample-level embeddings of single-cell data for reconstructing developmental and disease progression across samples.

name: scSNV-seq
full_name: single-cell genotyping and transcriptomics of single nucleotide variants
title: scSNV-seq: high-throughput phenotyping of single nucleotide variants by coupled single-cell genotyping and transcriptomics
summary: Couples single-cell genotyping of SNVs with transcriptomics in the same cells, so CRISPR-screen phenotypes are assigned to exact variants.

name: scSPLAT
title: scSPLAT, a scalable plate-based protocol for single cell WGBS library preparation
summary: Plate-based, pooled single-cell whole-genome bisulfite library preparation using splinted ligation adapter tagging.

name: scSPRITE
full_name: Single-cell split-pool recognition of interactions by tag extension
title: Single-cell measurement of higher-order 3D genome organization with scSPRITE
summary: Split-pool barcoding of crosslinked DNA within single nuclei to map multiway 3D genome contacts.

name: SCSsim
title: SCSsim: an integrated tool for simulating single-cell genome sequencing data
summary: Simulator of single-cell genome sequencing data that models MALBAC whole-genome amplification, allele dropout and variation.

name: SCST
title: Constructing the spatiotemporal atlas of single-cell lineage trajectories in stereotypic biological structures
summary: Single-cell resolved spatiotemporal mapping that integrates spatial transcriptomics with scRNA-seq to place single cells in a developmental atlas.

name: scStripe
title: Regulatory-scale stripe analysis from single-cell Hi-C with scStripe
summary: Imputation-free statistical framework for detecting chromatin stripes in sparse single-cell Hi-C maps.

name: scSVAS
title: Somatic variant analysis suite: copy number variation clonal visualization online platform for large-scale single-cell genomics
summary: Online interactive visualisation platform for large-scale single-cell copy-number profiles and clonal structure.

name: scTab
title: scTab: Scaling cross-tissue single-cell annotation models
summary: Tabular neural-network model for automated cell-type annotation of scRNA-seq data across tissues.

name: scTACL
title: scTACL: a multitask topology-aware contrastive learning approach for single-cell transcriptomics analysis
summary: Contrastive-learning model that aligns a cell similarity graph with an embedding graph under a ZINB decoder, for imputation, clustering, batch correction and cell-cell interaction in scRNA-seq.

name: scTaILoR-seq
title: Single-cell long-read targeted sequencing reveals transcriptional variation in ovarian cancer
summary: Single-cell long-read isoform sequencing with hybridization capture of over a thousand genes, enabling isoform, SNV and allele-imbalance analysis in ovarian cancer.

name: scTAM-seq
title: scTAM-seq enables targeted high-confidence analysis of DNA methylation in single cells
summary: Targeted, bisulfite-free single-cell DNA methylation assay for up to 650 CpGs in up to 10,000 cells, also querying surface protein and somatic mutations.

name: scTAPS
title: Direct and bisulfite-free 5-methylcytosine and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine sequencing at single-cell resolution with scTAPS and scCAPS +
summary: Bisulfite-free, plate-based single-cell sequencing of 5mC and 5hmC at single-base resolution using enzymatic conversion.

name: scTEM-seq
title: scTEM-seq: Single-cell analysis of transposable element methylation to link global epigenetic heterogeneity with transcriptional programs
summary: Single-cell amplicon bisulfite sequencing of SINE Alu elements to estimate global methylation, paired with the transcriptome of the same cell.

name: scTensor
title: Uncovering hypergraphs of cell-cell interaction from single cell RNA-sequencing data
summary: Detects many-to-many cell-cell interaction patterns as hypergraphs using tensor decomposition of ligand-receptor expression.

name: scTF-seq
title: Dissecting the impact of transcription factor dose on cell reprogramming heterogeneity using scTF-seq
summary: Single-cell method that induces barcoded, doxycycline-inducible transcription factor overexpression and reads out transcriptomes to measure dose-dependent TF effects.

name: scTHS-seq
title: Integrative single-cell analysis of transcriptional and epigenetic states in the human adult brain
summary: Transposome hypersensitive-site profiling of single nuclei, run at high throughput alongside droplet snDrop-seq.

name: scTiger
title: A Community-Driven Single-Cell PBMC Reference Integrating Landmark Datasets Spanning Health and Disease
summary: Hierarchical label-transfer framework that projects a 192-subset PBMC annotation onto about 18 million additional PBMCs.

name: scTissueID
title: High resolution tissue and cell type identification via single cell transcriptomic profiling
summary: Single-cell annotation pipeline that uses high-confidence reference cells to identify cell and tissue types from scRNA-seq profiles.

name: scTL-seq
title: Single-cell TimeLapse-seq reveals MTA is an essential retrotransposon orchestrating mouse zygotic genome activation
summary: Single-cell variant of TimeLapse-seq that detects allele-resolved nascent RNA in individual mouse embryos.

name: scTOP
title: scTOP: physics-inspired order parameters for cellular identification and visualization
summary: Physics-inspired statistical approach that scores cell identity against a reference set of cell types without feature selection or dimensionality reduction.

name: sctransform
title: Normalization and variance stabilization of single-cell RNA-seq data using regularized negative binomial regression
summary: Regularised negative binomial regression with Pearson residuals for normalising and variance-stabilising scRNA-seq counts.

name: scTrio-seq

summary: Separates each cell's RNA from its nuclear DNA so copy number, DNA methylome and transcriptome come from one cell.

name: scVAR

summary: Variational autoencoder that learns genetic variation from scRNA-seq reads and fuses it with transcriptomes to resolve cell states.

name: scVDMC
full_name: variance-driven multitask clustering of single-cell RNA-seq data
title: A multitask clustering approach for single-cell RNA-seq analysis in Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa
summary: Variance-driven multitask clustering that jointly clusters single cells across several scRNA-seq experiments with shared cell-type markers.

name: scVelo
title: Generalizing RNA velocity to transient cell states through dynamical modeling
summary: Likelihood-based dynamical model of splicing kinetics that generalises RNA velocity to transient cell states.

name: scVI
title: Deep generative modeling for single-cell transcriptomics
summary: Variational autoencoder with a zero-inflated negative binomial likelihood for normalisation, batch correction, clustering and differential expression.

name: scvi-hub
title: Scvi-hub: an actionable repository for model-driven single-cell analysis
summary: Platform for sharing and reusing pretrained probabilistic models of single-cell omics data for query analysis.

name: scvi-tools
title: A Python library for probabilistic analysis of single-cell omics data
summary: Python library that implements probabilistic single-cell omics models under a standardised interface linked to Scanpy, Seurat and Bioconductor.

name: scvis
title: Interpretable dimensionality reduction of single cell transcriptome data with deep generative models
summary: Statistical model for visualising low-dimensional structure in single-cell gene expression data.

name: scVital
title: A deep-learning tool for species-agnostic integration of cancer cell states
summary: Variational autoencoder with a discriminator that embeds scRNA-seq data from different species into a shared latent space, with a new latent space similarity score.

name: scVIVA
title: scVIVA: a probabilistic framework for representation of cells and their environments in spatial transcriptomics
summary: Deep generative model that embeds cell states using both a cell's own and its neighbours' expression in spatial transcriptomics.

name: scWGBS
title: Single-cell DNA methylome sequencing and bioinformatic inference of epigenomic cell-state dynamics
summary: FACS-sorted single-cell whole-genome bisulfite sequencing for low-coverage DNA methylation maps across many cells.

name: SDevo
title: State-dependent evolutionary models reveal modes of solid tumour growth
summary: Bayesian state-dependent phylodynamic model that infers spatially varying division rates in tumours from the branching and mutation patterns of multi-region sequencing data.

name: SDR-seq
title: Functional phenotyping of genomic variants using joint multiomic single-cell DNA-RNA sequencing
summary: Joint single-cell profiling of up to 480 genomic DNA loci and genes, linking variant zygosity to gene expression.

name: SeaBase
title: SeaBase: a multispecies transcriptomic resource and platform for gene network inference
summary: Platform for sharing and searching multispecies transcriptome data and inferring gene networks.

name: SEAGALL
full_name: Single-cell Explainable Geometry-Aware Graph Attention Learning pipeLine
title: Geometry-aware graph attention networks to explain single-cell chromatin states and gene expression with SEAGALL
summary: Geometry-regularised autoencoder and explainable graph attention network that identifies which molecular features drive single-cell identity across omics data.

name: Seal
title: Spatiotemporal AI-based modeling of gene regulation and variant effects in the developing human brain using Seal
summary: Interpretable transfer-learning model predicting gene expression and variant effects across developing human brain regions, cell types and stages.

name: SEAM
title: Uncovering the Mechanistic Landscape of Regulatory DNA with Deep Learning
summary: Deep-learning and attribution framework that maps how mutations preserve, disrupt or create transcription-factor binding sites in regulatory DNA.

name: SeAMotE
title: SeAMotE: a method for high-throughput motif discovery in nucleic acid sequences.
summary: Motif-discovery algorithm and web server that finds enriched motifs in high-throughput ChIP and CLIP sequence sets.

name: SEAseq
title: SEAseq: a portable and cloud-based chromatin occupancy analysis suite
summary: Portable cloud-based pipeline suite for analysing ChIP-seq and CUT&RUN chromatin occupancy data.

name: SEC-seq
title: Associating growth factor secretions and transcriptomes of single cells in nanovials using SEC-seq
summary: Hydrogel nanovials capture single cells with their secreted protein, which is tagged and linked to the cell transcriptome.

name: SECANT
full_name: biology-guided SEmi-supervised method for Clustering, classification, and ANnotation of single-cell multi-omics
title: SECANT: a biology-guided semi-supervised method for clustering, classification, and annotation of single-cell multi-omics
summary: Semi-supervised method that uses surface-protein data to guide clustering, classification and annotation of CITE-seq style single-cell multi-omics.

name: SECAPR
title: SECAPR-a bioinformatics pipeline for the rapid and user-friendly processing of targeted enriched Illumina sequences, from raw reads to alignments
summary: Pipeline turning raw sequence-capture reads into multiple sequence alignments for phylogenetic and phylogeographic analysis.

name: Seedability
title: Seedability: optimizing alignment parameters for sensitive sequence comparison
summary: Framework estimating optimal seed k-mer length and shared-seed threshold for sensitive alignment of short and divergent sequences.

name: SEEK
title: Targeted exploration and analysis of large cross-platform human transcriptomic compendia
summary: Query-based search engine that prioritises datasets and co-regulated genes across large transcriptomic compendia.

name: SeeNV
title: Rapid, Reliable, and Interpretable Copy Number Variant Curation Visualizations for Diagnostic Settings with SeeNV
summary: Visualisation tool for rapid, interpretable curation of copy number variants from exome data.

name: SEER-Map

summary: Automated sequential FISH imaging of microbial communities that maps taxa in situ over dozens of hybridisation rounds.

name: SEGF

summary: Fusion gene detection from single-end DNA-seq data by combining BLAST and SOAP alignment with stringent filters.

name: SegFinder

summary: Tool that identifies complete segments of segmented RNA viruses from metagenomic libraries by their co-occurrence at similar abundance.
